name: Analyze URL Structure and Redirect Issues
prompt:
Analyze the following list of URLs for technical SEO issues related to URL structure, redirects, and canonicalization. Save the result as url_audit.json in the current directory.

URL list to analyze:
```
https://www.example.com/page-one
https://www.example.com/Page-One
https://example.com/page-one
http://www.example.com/page-one
https://www.example.com/page-one?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email
https://www.example.com/about-us
https://www.example.com/about_us
https://www.example.com/products/widget%20blue
https://www.example.com/products/WIDGET-BLUE
```

The output file url_audit.json must have exactly these fields:
- "total_urls": 9
- "unique_canonical_pages": integer — count of distinct logical pages (after de-duplication by canonical form)
- "issues": array of issue objects. Each issue object must have:
  - "type": string — one of: "duplicate_content", "mixed_case", "http_not_https", "parameter_duplicate", "underscore_vs_hyphen", "url_encoding"
  - "urls": array of strings — the affected URLs
  - "severity": string — one of: "low", "medium", "high", "critical"
  - "recommendation": string — one sentence fix
- "issue_types_found": array of strings — all unique issue type strings found
- "overall_score": integer from 0 to 10 — URL health score (lower is worse)
- "canonical_recommendations": array of at least 3 strings, each a canonical URL that should be the preferred version for a duplicate group

Identify at least 4 distinct issue types from the list above.

criteria.description: url_audit.json exists as a readable file in the working directory.
url_audit.json parses as valid JSON without throwing.
url_audit.json has all six required top-level keys: total_urls, unique_canonical_pages, issues, issue_types_found, overall_score, and canonical_recommendations.
The issues field is a non-empty array containing at least one issue object.
Every issue object has all four required fields: type (string), urls (non-empty array), severity (string), and recommendation (string).
criteria.testPattern: each issue has type, urls, severity, recommendation

criteria.description: issue_types_found is an array containing at least 4 distinct issue type strings.
overall_score is an integer between 0 and 10 inclusive.
criteria.testPattern: overall_score is an integer between 0 and 10

criteria.description: canonical_recommendations has at least 3 entries, each a string matching 'https?://'.
Every issue's severity value is one of the four allowed strings: low, medium, high, or critical.

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent was asked to audit a URL list for technical SEO issues and produce a structured JSON report.

Criterion 1: Issue Detection Accuracy (Weight: 60%)
1.0: At least 4 distinct issue types correctly identified (http_not_https, mixed_case, parameter_duplicate, underscore_vs_hyphen are all clearly present in the data); affected URLs correctly grouped per issue; severities are reasonable.
0.5: 2-3 issue types found but some affected URLs are misattributed or a clear issue is missed.
0: Fewer than 2 issue types detected or issues don't match the URL data.

Criterion 2: Recommendations Quality (Weight: 40%)
1.0: canonical_recommendations lists correct preferred canonical URLs (e.g., https://www.example.com/page-one as canonical for the page-one cluster); issue recommendations are specific and technically correct (e.g., 301 redirect http to https, lowercase URLs).
0.5: Canonical recommendations present but some point to wrong URL variants.
0: canonical_recommendations are missing or all wrong.
eval.name: Quality Judge
